responsibility: Declares the common support API for Rust builtin macro expansion helpers. It publishes utility functions used across builtin macro handlers for token/fragment construction, eager invocation bookkeeping, macro-argument parsing with MacroInvocLexer and Parser, string-literal extraction, file path and byte loading, and related diagnostics/session interactions that underpin include!, concat!, env!, cfg!, and similar builtins.
same_name_distinction: Declares the cross-cutting helper API consumed by builtin macro expansion code throughout gcc/rust/expand. Unlike the paired implementation file, it is the shared declaration surface for those utilities, not the code that performs parsing assistance, fragment creation, or file/path handling.
